Question: What is the difference between the representation task and the learning-to-learn task?
Evidence:
[E1] (text, Section Figure 7, page 7): Figure 7. Results of our DAM representation trained using stochas- tic gradient descent (1st column) , our DAMs produced by our learning-to-learn network (2nd column) as well as a reference (3rd column) in a novel-view task. measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). Task View Method Error PNT ENV Representation (Sec. 3.2) Same OUR .105 .123 RM++ .143 .160 Novel OUR .144 .164 RM++ .181 .193 Learn-to-learn (Sec. 3.3) Same OUR .106 .131 SGD .105 .123 Novel OUR .165 .173 SGD .144 .164 Segmentation (Sec. 3.4) Same OUR .113 .122 KMEANS .132 .136 Novel OUR .161 .154 KMEANS .172 .164
[E2] (text, Section Figure 6, page 6): Figure 6. Pairs of error plots for each task. In each pair, the ﬁrst is the old and the second the new view. Each curve is produced by sorting the DSSIM (less is better) of all samples in the data set. Blue colors are for point light illumination, red colors for environment maps. Dark hues are the competitor and light hues ours. Old view Ours Other Ours Other Error Error Error Rank Rank Rank Error Rank Error Rank Error Rank Envmap Pointlight New view Representation Learning-to-learn Segmentation and estimation Old view New view Old view New view 1000 .4 0 1000 .4 1000 .4 0 1000 .4 88 .4 0 1000 .4 0 0 0 0 0 0
[E3] (text, Section Figure 3, page 4): Figure 3. Different appearance processing tasks that we address using our deep appearance maps. a) The ﬁrst task simply reproduces a given appearance, i. e., it maps from normal and view directions to RGB values using a NN. b) In a learning-to-learn task a network maps an image to a DAM representation. c) Finally, in the segmentation-and-estimation task, a network maps an image to multiple DAMs and multiple segmentation networks. 
[E4] (text, Section Table 1, page 7): Table 1. Quantitative results on synthetic data. Rows are different combination of tasks and methods (three applications, two view protocols, our two methods). Columns are different data. Error is measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). Task View Method Error PNT ENV Representation (Sec. 3.2) Same OUR .105 .123 RM++ .143 .160 Novel OUR .144 .164 RM++ .181 .193 Learn-to-learn (Sec. 3.3) Same OUR .106 .131 SGD .105 .123 Novel OUR .165 .173 SGD .144 .164 Segmentation (Sec. 3.4) Same OUR .113 .122 KMEANS .132 .136 Novel OUR .161 .154 KMEANS .172 .164

These claims are already verified and kept:
- The learning-to-learn task maps an image to a DAM representation, as described in Figure 3b.
- The segmentation-and-estimation task maps an image to multiple DAMs and multiple segmentation networks, as described in Figure 3c.

These claims failed the checks; write corrected claims to replace them:
- "The representation task involves mapping from normal and view directions to RGB values using a neural network, as described in Figure 3a.": the quote is not in E3
- "The representation task and the learning-to-learn task differ in their objectives: the former focuses on reproducing appearance, while the latter aims to learn a DAM representation.": the quote is not in E3
- "The representation task maps from normal and view directions to RGB values using a neural network, as described in Figure 3a.": the quote is not in E3
